SUMMARY: This factory builds a single curved (spiral-arc) staircase as one coherent assembly: an arc of treads/steps sweeping through a configurable angle, with optional supports (rails/sides), handrails, posts, bars, or glass panels. CurvedStaircaseFactory subclasses StraightStaircaseFactory, overriding only the size config and the geometry warp (make_spiral / unmake_spiral) that bends the straight staircase geometry into an arc of given radius/angle. All step generation, materials, rails, handrails, posts, and finalization logic live in straight.py and are inherited.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/elements/staircases/curved.py
  CurvedStaircaseFactory: curved-arc variant; warps straight staircase into a sweep.
    knobs: support_types weighted_choice(single-rail=2, double-rail=2, side=4, solid=4, hole=4) -> which support style is sampled (fixed weights)
    knobs: handrail_types weighted_choice(horizontal-post=2, vertical-post=2) -> handrail style (no glass here, unlike parent)
    knobs: has_spiral(True fixed) -> forces arc warp on
    knobs: full_angle(np.random.randint(1,5)*pi/2, i.e. 90/180/270/360°) -> total sweep of the arc (sampled)
    knobs: n(randint 13..21) -> number of steps (sampled)
    knobs: step_height(=wall_height/n) -> per-step rise
    knobs: theta(=full_angle/n) -> angular span per step
    knobs: step_length(=step_height*log_uniform(1,1.5)) -> tread depth (sampled)
    knobs: step_width(log_uniform(0.9,1.5)) -> stair width (sampled)
    knobs: radius(=step_length/theta, derived) -> arc radius; loop re-samples until radius/step_width>1.5 to avoid too-tight curves
  make_spiral / unmake_spiral: forward/inverse polar warp mapping straight coords to arc; edit to change curvature mapping.
  upper (property): pi/2 + full_angle -> valid orientation range for placement.

FILE: assets/objects/elements/staircases/straight.py  (parent — inherited by curved)
  StraightStaircaseFactory.__init__: samples all component presence/dimensions/materials.
    knobs: hole_size(log_uniform(0.6,1.0)) -> underside opening for "hole" support
    knobs: rail_offset(step_width*uniform(0.15,0.3)) -> inset of double rails
    knobs: is_rail_circular(uniform<0.5) -> round vs box rail cross-section
    knobs: rail_width(log_uniform(0.08,0.2)), rail_height(log_uniform(0.08,0.12)) -> rail thickness
    knobs: has_tread(True or uniform<0.75) -> whether tread caps exist
    knobs: tread_height(0.01-0.02 stepped / 0.06-0.08 solid), tread_length(+uniform 0.01-0.02), tread_width(step_width +0-0.02) -> tread size/overhang
    knobs: side_type(choice zig-zag/straight), side_height(step_height*log_uniform(0.2,0.8)), side_thickness(uniform 0.03-0.08) -> stringer look
    knobs: is_handrail_circular(uniform<0.7), handrail_width/height(log_uniform 0.02-0.06), handrail_offset(width*log_uniform1-2), handrail_extension(uniform 0.1-0.2) -> handrail shape/overhang
    knobs: post_height(log_uniform 0.8-1.2), post_k(ceil(step_width/step_length)), post_width(handrail_width*log_uniform0.6-0.8), post_minor_width(post_width*log_uniform0.3-0.5), is_post_circular(uniform<0.5) -> baluster spacing/size/shape
    knobs: bar_size(log_uniform 0.1-0.2), n_bars(floor(post_height/bar_size*uniform0.35-0.75)) -> horizontal bar count/spacing
    knobs: glass_height(post_height-uniform0-0.05), glass_margin(step_height/2+uniform0-0.05) -> glass panel extent
    knobs: mirror(uniform<0.5), rot_z(randint(4)*pi/2) -> global orientation
    knobs: end_margin(step_length*8) -> placeholder landing extension
    knobs: step_surface/tread_surface/rail_surface/side_surface/handrail_surface/post_surface/glass_surface -> materials weighted-sampled from material_assignments (change probs arrays [3,2,2,...] to bias)
  build_size_config: overridden in curved; parent defaults n(13..21), step_width(uniform 0.8-1.6), step_length(step_height*log_uniform0.8-1.2).
  make_steps / make_rails / make_treads / make_inner_sides / make_outer_sides / make_handrails / make_posts / make_bars / make_glasses: per-part geometry builders.
  create_asset: assembles enabled parts, applies spiral warp, mirror, rotation -> single joined object.
  finalize_assets: assigns per-selection materials (steps/treads/rails/sides/handrails/posts/glasses).
  make_guardrail / valid_contour / lower / upper: placement/room-integration helpers.

NOTE: no explicit stone/granite/coping/algae material logic exists; step/tread/side surfaces come from material_assignments.step/tread/side. To get worn granite + algae staining or a rounded outer coping, add new geometry (coping bevel on outer side) and material overrides here.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> weighted material pools (step, tread, rail, side, handrail, post, glasses)
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> read_co/write_co, mirror, subsurf, remove_faces/vertices, write_attribute helpers
  assets/utils/mesh.py -> canonicalize_ls, convert2ls line/shape utilities
  assets/utils/nodegroup.py -> geo_radius node group for tube/rounded profiles
  assets/utils/object.py -> primitive/mesh creation (new_line, new_cube, new_circle, join_objects, mesh2obj)
  assets/utils/shapes.py -> cut_polygon_by_line polygon slicing
  core/constraints/constraint_language/constants.py -> RoomConstants (wall_height, wall_thickness, door_size)
  core/nodes/* -> Nodes, NodeWrangler geometry-node graph API
  core/placement/detail.py -> sharp_remesh_with_attrs remeshing
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class
  core/surface.py -> material assignment, add_geomod, attribute read/write
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> subpart tagging (Wall/Ceiling/SupportSurface/Visible)
  core/util/blender.py -> butil modifier/edit-mode/transform helpers
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed, normalize
  core/util/random.py -> log_uniform, weighted_sample, random_general (rg) samplers
